description: The UMTAS service contract. **Paths** contains callable HTTP operations. **Schemas** also contains the queue, object-storage, callback, and CLI data exchanged between services. Runtime Zod schemas enforce cross-field rules that OpenAPI cannot express.

boundaries.purpose: Expose authentication, timetable, import, solver, and management operations to the web application.
boundaries.security: Operation-specific: public, session cookie, or role checks

boundaries.purpose: Make an uploaded PDF available to the parser without placing file bytes on the queue.
boundaries.security: Service credentials on the internal network
boundaries.failure: Upload or download failure ends the parser job

boundaries.purpose: Assign a stored PDF to the parser worker.
boundaries.data: Job ID, object key, and parser adapter key
boundaries.security: Authenticated Redis connection on the internal network
boundaries.failure: BullMQ retries the job; the final failure is returned by callback

boundaries.purpose: Run the Python parser against the downloaded PDF.
boundaries.data: PDF path and adapter key in; structured parser result out
boundaries.failure: Non-zero exit, timeout, or invalid JSON becomes a failed callback

boundaries.purpose: Return the final parser result or error and update the stored job.
boundaries.data: Completed result or structured worker error
boundaries.failure: Callback delivery retries three times; repeated identical callbacks are accepted

boundaries.purpose: Assign a prepared timetable problem to the solver worker.
boundaries.data: Job ID, attempt token, solve mode, and engine choice
boundaries.security: Authenticated Redis connection on the internal network
boundaries.failure: BullMQ retries the job; the final failure is returned by callback

boundaries.purpose: Give the worker the current scheduling problem and preferences.
boundaries.failure: Missing, rejected, or invalid input fails the worker attempt

boundaries.purpose: Return the final solution or error and update the active job attempt.
boundaries.data: Completed solver result or structured worker error
boundaries.security: Worker bearer token and attempt token
boundaries.failure: Callback delivery retries three times; stale attempts are rejected

boundaries.purpose: Execute CP-SAT or GA outside the worker runtime.
boundaries.data: Solver input file, engine and mode flags, then solver output file
boundaries.failure: Timeout, invalid output, or infeasibility becomes a failed callback; auto mode may fall back to GA

boundaries.purpose: Sign in or link an account with a Google identity.
boundaries.data: Authorization redirect, code, state, and OpenID profile
boundaries.contract: OpenAPI Auth Google paths; scopes: openid, email, profile
boundaries.security: OAuth state cookie, HTTPS redirect, and encrypted stored tokens
boundaries.failure: Provider and callback errors return through the authentication flow

Queue_PdfParseJob.description: BullMQ job payload sent by the NestJS backend to the PDF parser worker on the `pdf.parse` queue. Runtime authority: `PdfParseJobDataSchema` in `packages/shared-types/src/parser.ts`.

Object_PdfUpload.description: PDF bytes written by the backend and downloaded by the parser worker using the `fileKey` from `Queue_PdfParseJob`.

Queue_TimetableSolveJob.description: BullMQ job payload sent by the NestJS backend to the solver worker on the `timetable.solve` queue. Runtime authority: `TimetableSolveJobDataSchema` in `packages/shared-types/src/solver.ts`.

Worker_PdfParserResult.description: Structured parser result produced by the PDF parser worker. Every event is either recurring (`isRecurring: true`, `day` set, `date: null`) or dated (`isRecurring: false`, `date` set, `day: null`). Runtime rule: `startTime` must be earlier than `endTime`.

Cli_PdfParserOutput.description: JSON written to stdout by the Python parser after a successful parse.

Worker_SolverInput.description: Scheduling problem and preferences returned by the backend to the solver worker and written as the native solver input JSON file. Each scheduling event must contain exactly one of `date` or `dayOfWeek`, and `startTime` must be earlier than `endTime`.

Worker_SolverResult.description: Normalized solver result returned by the solver worker. Runtime rules: `metadata.conflictCount` equals `metadata.conflicts.length`; `outcome` is `conflict-free` when the count is zero and `best-effort` otherwise.

Http_PdfParserCallback.description: Discriminated HTTP callback sent by the PDF parser worker. A completed callback contains only `status` and `result`; a failed callback contains only `status` and `error`.

Http_SolverCallback.description: Discriminated HTTP callback sent by the solver worker. A completed callback contains only `status` and `result`; a failed callback contains only `status` and `error`.

Cli_SolverInput.description: JSON file passed to the native solver with `--input`. Its content is the solver input retrieved from the backend.

Cli_SolverOutput.description: JSON file written by the native solver to the `--output` path. Runtime authority: `SolverCliOutputSchema` in `packages/shared-types/src/solver.ts`. A successful process writes exactly one of the feasible or infeasible shapes.
